summary: Add drawing practice and explicit electron-counting guidance for the species learners are most likely to misrepresent.

improvements.why: The pack has 29 MCQs but only one structured drawing item; the examiner report records reversed donor direction in CO and incorrect covalent drawings of Mg2Si.
improvements.what: Add original structured Show or Sketch tasks requiring complete dot-and-cross diagrams for CO with its O-to-C coordinate pair, bracketed Mg2Si ions with four electrons transferred to Si, and an electron-deficient or expanded-octet species such as BF3 or PCl5. Require every outer electron, symbol origin, lone pair and charge to be markable; give schemes, explanations and three progressive hints. Do not duplicate past-paper stems.

improvements.where: note, after the paragraph on coordinate bonding in ## Key ideas
improvements.why: The note names the O-to-C donation in CO but does not walk through its electron accounting; ER 9701 s22 P23 Q3 reports students drawing three ordinary pairs or reversing the donor.
improvements.what: Add a compact step-by-step CO dot-and-cross account: ten valence electrons in total, two ordinary shared pairs, one O-supplied shared pair, and one lone pair on each atom. Explain that the symbols record electron origin in this conventional construction and that the arrow points from O to C.

improvements.why: The method gives the general charge rule, but the note does not fully model electron placement for Mg2Si, the ionic drawing singled out in ER 9701 s19 P21 Q2.
improvements.what: Add a brief Mg2Si check showing two separate [Mg] 2+ ions and one [Si] 4- ion, with eight outer electrons around Si: four originally from Si and four transferred from the two Mg atoms. State that only outer-shell electrons and correct brackets and charges are required.
